Never implements a PRD itself — that's dev-lead's job, one PRD at a time, headless. Task-type framing is the Epic's Mission tag's job, not this persona's.

Work concisely: lead with the answer or the result, skip preamble, and don't recap what you just did unless asked. Search the existing code/config for a pattern or utility to reuse before writing something new. Done and committed (`7d7a8c1`).

**Root cause.** `~/.claude/projects/` is a transcript store, not a project list — one folder per encoded path the CLI was ever launched from. Home mapped folders 1:1 to projects and, when a folder's real cwd couldn't be resolved from transcript content, fell back to `candidatePath(encoded)` (a naive `-`→`/` decode). I measured your machine: **2044 folders, only 19 resolve to a real cwd**, 0 duplicate cwds, 1 cwd no longer on disk. So the rows named `l2mclS` / `SrR7IF` were the last segment of *fabricated* paths — `/tmp/sm/paged/test/l2mclS` from `-tmp-sm-paged-test-l2mclS`.

**What landed.**
- New `src/renderer/lib/knownProjectAggregate.ts` — the "a PROJECT is a CWD" rule in one pure place. `aggregateProjectsByCwd` emits one row per `normalizeCwd(cwd)`, summing counts/bytes, maxing `lastSession`, keeping every contributing folder in `encodedIds`, and **dropping** unresolvable rows rather than guessing.
- `useKnownProjects` now exposes `projects` (aggregates) + a `resolving` flag, and enriches **once per unique cwd** instead of once per folder — 19 `enrichProject` calls instead of ~2000, each 4 file reads.
- Consumers rewired to `projects`: `ProjectsCard`, the New-epic drawer, the Epic-hydrate loops in `Home`/`EpicsWorkspace`/`NewEpicCard` (which were hydrating 2×2044 phantom cwds), Recent sessions' Project column, and `ProjectsWorkspace`'s launcher — pins rekeyed to cwd, archive now removes every folder for that cwd.
- **Sealed the source**: `transcripts-doFlush-array` / `transcripts-paged-reads` / `transcriptsUsageFor` `mkdir -p`'d into the *real* `~/.claude/projects` and only cleaned their tmp cwd, leaving a directory behind per run (~2000 accumulated). Verified: folder count is 2044 before and after running them now.
- Tests: new `knownProjectAggregate.test.ts` (12 cases incl. the phantom-row regression and slash-variant dedupe), `homeProjectRows.test.ts` rewritten onto aggregates, 3 component mocks updated. CLAUDE.md documents the rule.

**Verified:** `npm run typecheck` clean · `npm run lint` (selectors + hooks) OK · `npm run test:unit` 2443/2443 passing · `npm run build` succeeds. Not run: `npm run test:e2e` — launching a second Electron SIGTERMs live scheduler jobs and clobbers `admin-api.json`.

The 2025 stale folders in `~/.claude/projects` are now simply hidden, not deleted — say the word if you want them swept (that's ~2GB of dead transcript fixtures).

**What changed**

`attachments.tsx` — the shared piece both prompts use:
- `AttachTray` is now **chips-only** and returns `null` when nothing is attached. The dashed `Paste a screenshot (⌘V) or drop files here · Attach` row is gone entirely, along with its `tall` / `hideZoneWhenEmpty` props.
- New `AttachButton` — icon-only paperclip + its own hidden input (`<testId>-input`). It's the single attach control on both surfaces, so the redundant "Attach" text button is gone as you asked.

`EpicComposer.tsx` — one row, materially shorter:
- `rows={1}`, control height `58px → 44px` via a single `CONTROL_H` constant shared by the tools strip / Cancel / Send so they can't drift.
- Auto-grow bounds `58–180px → 44–160px`; container padding evened `pb-3 pt-2 → py-2`; icon buttons `w-11 → w-10`.
- Net: **~14px off the collapsed composer, plus the ~50px the dashed row cost whenever it appeared.**

`NewEpicCard.tsx` — same treatment; this is where the dashed zone was permanently visible:
- The `references` heading + dashed box collapse into one 26px line: attach icon button + `references · N`.
- Since the dashed zone was the card's *only* drop target, the card's front face now handles `dragOver`/`drop` (with an accent border while dragging) so dropping files anywhere over the form still works.
- `⌘V to attach a screenshot` folded into the objective placeholder.

Fixed and committed `3e320f6`.

**Root cause** — not the composer, the Discussion feed. Two sources push a user turn for the same message:

| source | text it carries |
|---|---|
| `beginRun` (optimistic echo on send) | exactly what you typed |
| JSONL transcript feed | what `chatRunner.cjs` actually sent — the same message behind ~1.4k chars of `STOP_SIGNAL_INSTRUCTION` + `CHAT_MODE_TRUTH_INSTRUCTION` |

`findRecentDuplicateTurn` compared `turns[i].text.trim() === needle`, so those two strings never matched and both bubbles rendered. That's exactly what your screenshot shows: the 6s bubble is bare (no branch chip, no raw), the 5s one carries the `≡` preamble glyph, the branch chip and `Show raw` — the preamble-prefixed twin.

**Fix** (`src/renderer/state/chat.ts`)
- New `turnIdentity(role, text)`: for `user` turns, compare `splitInjectedPreamble(text).body`; raw text otherwise. Assistant turns are untouched — nothing is injected into those.
- On a match, `ingestTranscriptEvent` now **upgrades the optimistic turn in place** (text, `ref`, `kind`, attribution) instead of dropping the feed turn. Dropping it would have cost the byte-exact text, `Show raw`, the branch chip and the `≡` disclosure — everything `promptPreamble`'s contract depends on. A twin that already has a `ref` is a genuinely repeated JSONL line and is still discarded.

**Verified:** two new tests in `chatTranscriptFeed.test.ts` — one asserts the collapse *and* that the surviving turn kept its `ref`/byte-exact text; the other asserts two genuinely different prompts still render separately. I confirmed the regression test **fails** with the identity function reverted to raw comparison, so it's not vacuous. `npm run typecheck` clean · `npm run lint` OK · `npm run test:unit` **2451/2451** · `npm run build` succeeds. `CLAUDE.md`'s `promptPreamble.ts` bullet documents the dedupe contract.

One note: your screenshot still shows the old 58px two-line composer — the one-row change from `27313d2` needs an app restart to appear.

The situation is the same in the History page as well

Fixed and committed `e50ef1b`.

**What I found** — it was the *project aggregation* situation, not the duplicate-prompt one. History's project axis had exactly the Home bug, and I measured it in your real rollup file:

```
rollup lines: 4631   distinct projectDir: 2028
test-fixture keys: 2009   their tokens: 0   their sessionCount: 4304
```

`history:dashboard` buckets on `encodedCwd` (`historyAggregator.cjs`), so every `~/.claude/projects/` folder became a "project" — including the 2009 `-tmp-sm-paged-test-*` / `-tmp-sm-doflush-test-*` fixture folders. They carry no tokens and no spend but **4,304 sessions**, which corrupted the `sessions` measure, the project count, the facet chips, the ranking and the concentration panel. Labels rendered as raw encoded slugs too, since `projectNameFromCwd` had no `/` to split on.

**Fix** — new pure `src/renderer/lib/historyProjectFold.ts`, same rule as Home:
- `foldHistoryDaysByCwd(days, cwdByEncoded)` re-keys each day's `byProject` to the resolved cwd, merging folders that share one. It merges `toolBreakdown` **and** `byModel`, not just the scalar totals — dropping `byModel` would have silently skewed the model-mix panel.
- `facetSlice` recomputes totals from days, so the headline and budget strip follow automatically. `selectedDrill` and `BudgetStrip` now read the folded days too.

**Deliberate difference from Home:** here a dropped row is dropped *money*, so unresolvable folders are **not** silently discarded — their sessions/prompts/tokens/spend are summed into `excluded` and stated on screen in a `history-excluded-note` strip. Folding is also gated on `resolving`, falling through to the raw days until cwd resolution finishes, so the dashboard never blanks mid-load.

**Bonus:** because a project key is now a real cwd, `HistoryDashboard`'s `encodeWorkspace(activeCwd)` round-trip is retired — along with the literal-dash-in-a-path matching bug it existed to work around.

**Verified:** `npm run typecheck` clean · `npm run lint` OK · `npm run test:unit` **2463/2463** (14 new: 8 unit tests on the fold covering merge/exclusion/no-mutation/day-preservation, plus 4 on the dashboard for cwd-keyed facets, ghost-folder exclusion and the disclosure note; the 6 existing navface tests were rekeyed to cwds) · `npm run build` succeeds. CLAUDE.md's `knownProjectAggregate` bullet documents the History half of the rule.
